description: ID collision probability calculator — Birthday-bound collision odds for random IDs: UUID v4/v7, ULID, KSUID, nanoid, cuid2, or any alphabet and length. Returns entropy bits, collision probability and expected collisions for ids= generated, ids needed for 1e-9/1e-6/1%/50% risk, time to reach them at rate=, the shortest safe length per alphabet, and a SAFE/OK/RISKY/UNSAFE verdict. Params: format (uuid4|uuid7|ulid|ksuid|nanoid|cuid2|hex|base32|base36|base58|base62|base64|numeric|alphanumeric|lower) or alphabet= (size or the characters) with length=, or bits=; ids (e.g. 1e9, 10M); rate (e.g. 1000/s, 5M/day; per-ms for uuid7/ulid); target probability (default 1e-9). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_id_collision
